description.text: [npc.Name] [npc.verb(work)] a little warm water into [npc.her] [npc.spinneret], past the opening, and [npc.verb(let)] it run back out until nothing cloudy follows. [npc.She] [npc.verb(keep)] [npc.her] touch light. [npc.speech(Inside the opening. A wipe is not enough.)]

[npc.Name] [npc.verb(let)] hot water push into [npc.her] [npc.spinneret] and [npc.verb(coax)] it back out with a careful finger, shivering at how much [npc.she] [npc.verb(feel)]. [npc.speech(Careful, but deeper. I want it clear.)]
[npc.Name] [npc.verb(flush)] [npc.her] [npc.spinneret] out in a few firm rinses and [npc.verb(stop)] the moment it runs clear. [npc.speech(Out. That is as deep as I am going.)]
